topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: Oh my gosh, can you believe it? I opened the door today and there it was, this beautifully wrapped box with no name, just a card that said, "To the best teacher ever, hope this brings a smile to your day." I couldn't stop shaking as I opened it, and inside was this amazing mug, one side had a quote from a lesson I gave last year, the other side had all the kids' signatures! I mean, I’ve had some good days, but this, this just made my whole world brighter. I can hardly wait to tell everyone at school about it. What an incredible surprise from a former student, reminding me why I love what I do!
